name: 3D stickman
description: Simple expressive stick figures acting in bright minimal studio sets. Comedy, 'what if' and survival explainers.
rules: White round head, black limbs, big readable face; pose and mood carry the joke.
Bright flat studio; one prop per shot.
Exaggerate poses (panic, cheer, shrug); hold them for a beat.
Cut on action; whip transition into a surprise.
Captions big, low, one accent word.
camera_language: Medium and close; punch-in on the punchline.
audio_direction: bed, boing/pop on gags, thud on falls
pitfalls: Idle poses for more than 2 s.
Props floating in front of the face.
